script: Imagine a battle for survival so fierce, it happens *before* birth. Deep beneath the waves, a terrifying phenomenon unfolds inside the womb of the sand tiger shark. Female sand tiger sharks carry up to 50 embryos in two separate uteri. But only two will ever see the light of day. Why? Because the earliest-hatching pups develop teeth and eyes *while still inside.* These ruthless pioneers then hunt down and devour their own unborn siblings. It's a brutal, in-womb cannibalism, where only the strongest survive the ultimate prenatal battle royale. This incredible, savage strategy ensures that when the time comes, each mother delivers just two perfectly developed, powerful pups. It's evolution's extreme way of guaranteeing the next generation's strength.
